item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I’m Ziheng Zhang 👋

I am a spatial computing developer and geomatics engineering student specializing in high-precision positioning algorithms and advanced spatial data analysis.

My technical focus lies at the intersection of rigorous mathematical adjustment and modern software engineering. I am passionate about translating complex photogrammetry and GNSS RTK theories into robust, production-ready code.

🛠️ Core Tech Stack

  • Languages: C++, Python, SQL
  • Spatial & GIS: ArcGIS, GNSS RTK Data Processing, Photogrammetry Algorithms
  • Tools & Workflows: Git, GitHub Actions, CLion, Hugo

🚀 What I Do

  • Spatial Algorithms: Developing high-performance single-photo spatial resection engines in pure C++.
  • Geospatial Analysis: Creating professional choropleth maps and intelligent underground utility network models.
  • Data Automation: Building automated workflows for topographic mapping and extensive spatial data processing using Python.

Feel free to connect with me for freelance projects or academic collaborations!
